description.value: While most creatures get cybernetic implants to enhance their bodies and minds or to restore lost abilities, many choose to make their enhancements as flashy as possible, matching their personal aesthetics or making a bold statement. Some, however, prefer to have just the flash, hold the enhancement. Cosmetic cybernetics have no mechanical benefit but alter your appearance in an obvious, dramatic way. They might represent cables and wires extending from your head or limbs, additional limbs that can't hold items, wings that can't fly, glowing patterns in your skin that offer no real illumination, a fiber-optic mohawk, or any of hundreds of other options, including those that resemble other types of augmentations. This augmentation doesn't count toward your implant limit.
